en.t: Really, the autumn wind has begun to blow.

units.source_text: 入秋以后，避暑地非常冷清，像港口的船儿全出了海一样……”

en.t: Once autumn comes, the summer resort grows terribly deserted, as if all the boats in the harbor had gone out to sea...

units.source_text: 澡塘里传出阿雪娇媚的声音。

en.t: From the bathhouse came Ayuki's coquettish voice.

units.source_text: 那是一种模仿热恋中的城市女子的声调。

en.t: It was a tone that imitated a city woman in the midst of passionate love.
